pickup_requests_outcome.name: pickup_requests_outcome
pickup_requests_outcome.value:
CASE "ordering"."pickup_requests"."status"
        WHEN 'open' THEN "ordering"."pickup_requests"."outcome" IS NULL AND "ordering"."pickup_requests"."closed_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'confirmed' THEN "ordering"."pickup_requests"."outcome" IN ('restaurant', 'automatic', 'operations') AND "ordering"."pickup_requests"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ordering"."pickup_requests"."booked_lines" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'rejected' THEN "ordering"."pickup_requests"."outcome" IN ('amount_incorrect', 'incomplete') AND "ordering"."pickup_requests"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "ordering"."pickup_requests"."outcome" = 'cancelled' AND "ordering"."pickup_requests"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL
      END

pickup_requests_received.name: pickup_requests_received
pickup_requests_received.value: ("ordering"."pickup_requests"."received_lines" IS NOT NULL) = ("ordering"."pickup_requests"."outcome" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'amount_incorrect')
